title: The Chvátal-Sankoff problem: Understanding random string comparison through stochastic processes
key_contribution: Links γ₂ to stationary density of a stochastic particle process using statistical mechanics and combinatorial LCS structure

title: The Chvátal-Sankoff problem as a problem of symbolic dynamics
key_contribution: Reformulates the problem in language of symbolic dynamics and cellular automata; reports computational experiments; corrects errors in previous paper

title: Thermodynamical Approach to the Longest Common Subsequence Problem
key_contribution: Introduces interacting particle model equivalent to binary LCS; derives differential equation linking LCS-curve to particle speed and density

title: Hammersley's interacting particle process and longest increasing subsequences
venue: Probability Theory and Related Fields, Vol. 103
key_contribution: Foundational paper connecting Hammersley's particle process to LIS; establishes the paradigm of particle systems for subsequence problems
